content: Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem until it reaches a base case.
A loop repeats instructions multiple times. Common types: for loops (counted) and while loops (condition-based).
An API (Application Programming Interface) allows two programs to talk to each other using requests and responses.
A list in Python is an ordered, mutable collection. You can add, remove, and access items by index.
Science is the system of acquiring knowledge through observation and experimentation to describe and explain natural phenomena.
